paper.title: The Ideal Glass and the Ideal Disk Packing in Two Dimensions
paper.reference: V. M. Bolton-Lum, R. C. Dennis, P. K. Morse and E. I. Corwin, arXiv:2404.07492v2 (2025); Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 058201 (2026)
paper.source_of_numbers: The estimates under 'protocol' come from an independent reproduction of the seeded-melting measurement (N = 64 triangulated packing built by the paper's route, Metropolis Monte Carlo, overlap threshold 0.3 mean radius, four seeds per temperature, up to 4e6 sweeps). The counts and theorem cases are read from the paper.

disks_radii_free.description: N disks on a torus while the radii are degrees of freedom (the preparation step and the count of the appendix).

disks_fixed_radii.description: The same N disks with the radii fixed: the system whose configurational entropy and melting are claimed.

disks_fixed_radii_any_packing.description: The fixed disks in any packing, triangulated or not.

claims.statement: The triangulated packings have zero configurational entropy, because triangulated graphs become a vanishing fraction of all graphs.

prior_art.statement: A triangulation of the torus fixes the radii up to scale; generic radii admit no triangulated packing.

sources: Chapuy et al., J. Combin. Theory A 118, 748 (2011)

prior_art.statement: Disordered ground states designed so that no crystal competes ('perfect glass').
queries: Zhang Stillinger Torquato perfect glass paradigm
sources: Zhang, Stillinger and Torquato, Sci. Rep. 6, 36963 (2016)

claims.statement: A triangulated packing must be the densest packing possible for its radii.

prior_art.statement: A triangulated torus packing whose small disks can be rearranged into a denser packing of the same disks.
queries: Fernique Pchelina compact packings are not always the densest
sources: Connelly et al., Discrete Comput. Geom. 64, 734 (2020), Sec. 12, Fig. 12.2

claims.statement: The packings melt at T_m = 0.00189, equal to the Kauzmann temperature.

protocol.quantity: melting temperature (divergence of the overlap time, modified Vogel-Fulcher fit)

prior_art.statement: Equilibrium two-dimensional polydisperse disks have a Kauzmann temperature at zero.
queries: Zero-temperature glass transition in two dimensions
equilibrium Kauzmann transition two-dimensional atomistic glass
sources: Jung, Ozawa, Biroli and Berthier, arXiv:2507.03590

claims.statement: A non-zero melting temperature in two dimensions suggests a violation of the Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg theorem.
The hard-disk melting density phi_m = 0.780 is the thermodynamic melting density.

prior_art.statement: A power-law fit of the 1/e overlap time locates the (avoided) dynamical transition.
queries: Charbonneau Hu Kundu Morse dimensional evolution structure dynamics hard sphere liquids
sources: Charbonneau, Hu, Kundu and Morse, J. Chem. Phys. 156, 134502 (2022)

claims.statement: Shear moduli without pressure scaling show, for the first time, that disordered ideal packings behave like crystals.

prior_art.statement: Hyperstatic networks (z > 2d) have a finite shear modulus at zero pressure, ordered or not.
